reason: I have sent more than ten applications with no answer, so if the free action really makes my CV fit the offer better, I would put 500 FCFA on the small pack for the next good offer. Not more than that until I see a reply from an employer.
objection: A score going from 68 to 86 is the app grading itself. Recruiters still might not answer, and then I spent money I don't have on a number.
would_change_my_mind: If the free try gives me a CV that looks generic or no better than mine, I don't pay anything.
